verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own docs show OpenAPI specs are automatically linted in the design view, with error type, line number and message. Spec linting can also run in CI via `inso lint spec`, failing builds on errors. However, nothing in the evidence shows the rules are configurable, or that custom style or governance rulesets can be defined. Missing for 10: documented configurable or custom style/governance rulesets, independent or hands-on corroboration of linting depth.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can lint API specs against configurable style and governance rules

citations.quote: Automatically linted. Errors display at the bottom of the center pane and include error type, line number, and error message
In CI, use `inso lint spec <identifier>` to lint OpenAPI and fail builds on errors.
It disables prompts and provides exit codes to pass or fail the CI workflow.
